text: You must stop whenever you approach a stopped school bus with its upper alternating red lights flashing, regardless of whether you are behind the bus or approaching it from the front.
If you are coming from behind the bus, stop at least 20 metres away.
Do not go until the bus moves or the lights have stopped flashing.
If you are on a road with a median strip, only vehicles coming from behind the bus must stop.
If you don't stop, you can be fined heavily and get six demerit points for a first offence.
If you are making a left turn behind one of these vehicles, do not pull up beside it to make your turn at the same time.
Stay behind and turn when the way is clear.
Slow traffic on multi-lane roads must keep right.
